entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-19
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Clean up generation of NetAnalyzers GenerateAnalyzerRulesMissingDocumentationFile stuff #50375
  • Investigate SDK tests running on .NET Framework to actually call msbuild.exe #50374
  • Support `--use-current-runtime` on `dotnet test` commands #50369
  • Consider making RID-agnostic marker tool package creation happen in more scenarios #50368
  • CA1859 shouldn't recommend using an anonymous type as return type #50366
  • Enable more code analysis rules for code analyzers #50365
  • dotnet build errors with a file locked by itself (concurrency issue) #50364
  • [NETE2ESDK][ARM64] x64 .NET 10 RC1 candidate SDK commands hang on ARM64 machines #50360

Closed

  • Default `dotnet new sln` to slnx now that VS has much better support for it #50022
  • Incorrect Chinese command suggestion in `dotnet workload repair` #50235
  • [10.0-preview.6] Cannot restore NuGet packages from feedz.io feed on macOS due to NU1301 error #49785
  • [NETE2ESDK][Mac][Linux][Regression] With .NET 10.0.100-rc.1.25409.103 Binaries, xunit project tested failed with error MSB6006 if DOTNET_ROOT was not set. #50331
  • Should `dotnet build app.cs` produce artifacts in the current directory? #50340
  • [WebToolsE2E]Create project failed with error “NETSDK1226: Prune Package data not found ” in CLI after installing SDK 10.0 RC1 #50079

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix ProductName for SDK placeholder #50378
  • Generate pruning data correctly (#50348) #50377
  • Allow `any`-RID builds to resolve assets like completely-RID-less builds #50376
    Area-Tools, 10.0.1xx
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Default `dotnet new sln` to slnx format for .NET 10 #50373
  • Fix updating `globaljsonworkloadsets.json` #50372
    Area-Workloads
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'main' #50371
  • Fix package prune data for .NET Core 2.x #50370
  • Use AnalysisMode=minimum in Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers and fix errors #50367
    Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers
  • Sort options alphabetically by name #50363

Merged

  • Generate pruning data correctly #50348
    Servicing-approved
  • Default `dotnet new sln` to slnx format for .NET 10 #50023
    Area-Templates
  • Fix Chinese translation of dotnet workload search command #50265
  • [automated] Update man pages #50306
  • [release/10.0.1xx-rc1] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #50361
  • Update to the July implicit version for the 1xx branch #50345
  • Add 10.0.1xx into the interbranch codeflow #50347
  • Move localization to the 1xx branch so we get translations for net10 #50346
  • Remove .NET Standard 2.1 Targeting Pack from installers #50354
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0.3xx' => 'main' #50317
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #50358
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 140: Build ID 2775022 #50338
    Area-Infrastructure
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #50300
  • [release/10.0.1xx-rc1] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #50308
  • Add the missing netcore installer to the bundle #50351

Updated

  • A handful of S.CL-related cleanups and reorgs from the OTel branch to minimize diffs #50164
    Area-CLI
  • Support CsWinRT 3.0 multi-targeting and WindowsSdkPackageMinimumRevision #50264
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Update the minimum msbuild version for .NET 10 #49531
  • Include localPath in deps.json for runtime assets #50120
  • Update to the September implicit version #50344
  • Consolidate default verbosity of msbuild-based commands #50243
    Area-run-file
  • Support `dotnet pack file.cs` #50168
    Area-run-file
  • Implement support for changing project and package references #49611
    Area-AspNetCore
  • Prepare delta applier for code sharing #49974
    Area-AspNetCore
  • Suggested perf improvements in DataFlowAnalysis #50310
  • Add PostAction for dotnet.config #50285
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Add support and tests for interpolating MSBuild properties and environment variables in launchProfile commandLineArgs #50159
    Area-CLI
  • Add net11.0 known framework references #50329
